faq.question: Is Amity Online UGC approved?
faq.answer: Yes, Amity University Online was among the first Indian universities recognised by the UGC to offer online degree programs under the 2018 regulations.

faq.question: Are Amity Online degrees equivalent to on-campus degrees?
faq.answer: UGC's 2018 online-education regulations treat an entitled online degree as equivalent to the corresponding on-campus degree. Equivalence depends on the specific programme being entitled for the session you enrol in, and individual employers or authorities set their own acceptance rules. Ask us to confirm the entitlement status of your programme before you apply.

faq.question: Is an Amity Online degree valid abroad?
faq.answer: Amity lists international accreditations and memberships on its own site. We have not independently verified these against the awarding bodies, and none of them guarantee recognition by any particular foreign university, employer, or immigration authority, which each apply their own criteria. Check directly with the institution or authority that matters for your plans.

faq.question: What is AMIGO?
faq.answer: AMIGO is Amity Online's learning management system, it centralises live classes, recorded lectures, audiobooks, e-books, assignments, and study materials in one place.

faq.question: What is Prof. Ami?
faq.answer: Prof. Ami is Amity's AI-powered personal tutor built into the platform, giving 24/7 doubt resolution and learning guidance.

faq.question: What is beSocial?
faq.answer: beSocial is Amity's virtual community platform, where learners connect, collaborate, join clubs, and take part in academic and extracurricular discussions.

faq.question: Can online students access campus activities?
faq.answer: Yes, online learners can take part in orientation events (Samagam), mid-year meetups, campus library and lab access, and on-campus convocation.

faq.question: Will I receive physical textbooks?
faq.answer: Amity Online is digital-first, comprehensive e-books, study materials, and recorded lectures come through AMIGO. Physical books may be available on request or depending on the specific program's fee structure.

faq.question: What laptop specs do I need for the BCA program?
faq.answer: Ideally an Intel Core i5 (or equivalent) processor, at least 8GB RAM, and a 256GB SSD, to comfortably run programming environments, databases, and IDEs.

faq.question: How do MCA students complete practical lab work?
faq.answer: Through virtual labs and cloud-based sandboxes (like AWS or Azure), where you can safely run code, test cybersecurity protocols, and train machine learning models.

faq.question: Do I get ACCA exemptions with the B.Com International Finance specialization?
faq.answer: Yes, this specialization offers exemptions from certain ACCA foundation and applied knowledge/skills exams, shortening your path to becoming an ACCA professional.

faq.question: Are internships mandatory for BBA students?
faq.answer: Not strictly for the general BBA, but strongly encouraged, Amity's placement cell helps students secure virtual internships to build their resumes.

faq.question: Is the BA program useful for UPSC preparation?
faq.answer: Yes, the BA program, especially the Political Science, Sociology, and Economics-leaning coursework, is a popular foundation for students preparing for UPSC and other civil-services exams.

faq.question: Why choose a combo (UG+PG) degree over separate degrees?
faq.answer: Combo degrees reduce friction by combining a UG and PG pathway into one continuous route, keep tuition at the combined program's rate rather than two separate applications, and get you into the workforce faster by removing the need to reapply for the postgraduate degree later.

faq.question: How can I pay Amity Online fees?
faq.answer: Through secure digital gateways, net banking, UPI, and credit/debit card. Amity also offers EMI plans and educational-loan options across most programs.

faq.question: Are LPU Online and Distance degrees valid for government jobs?
faq.answer: Yes, degrees earned via LPU Online and Distance modes are valid for all state and central government job applications, including UPSC, banking, and SSC, as per UGC guidelines.

faq.question: What are the eligibility criteria for LPU's placement assistance?
faq.answer: You need to clear all previous semester papers with no active backlogs, maintain a CGPA of 6.0 or higher, and complete the Professional Enhancement Programme (PEP) modules.

faq.question: Can LPU Online students attend on-campus placement drives?
faq.answer: Yes, LPU Online and Distance students can take part in on-campus placement drives, job mega-fairs, and corporate joint drives hosted in Jalandhar.

faq.question: What internet speed do I need for online exams?
faq.answer: A stable connection with a minimum upload/download speed of 2 Mbps. A mobile hotspot works, but a dedicated broadband link is recommended.

faq.question: Can I use a Chromebook for the Secure Exam Application?
faq.answer: No, the Secure Exam Application (SEA) doesn't support Chromebooks or iPadOS/iOS. It runs on Windows 10/11 (64-bit), macOS 10.15+ (Intel or Apple Silicon), Linux, and Android.

faq.question: What are the minimum system requirements for exams?
faq.answer: At least 4 GB RAM (8 GB recommended), a working webcam (min. 640×480) and microphone, and a screen resolution of 1024×768 or higher.

faq.question: Is the LMS accessible on holidays?
faq.answer: Yes, the e-Connect LMS portal operates 24/7/365, so recorded lectures, the digital library, and assignments are available on Sundays and national holidays too.

faq.question: What happens if there's a power cut during my exam?
faq.answer: Your answers save in real time. If you lose power or your system crashes, log back in within 15 minutes to resume exactly where you left off.

faq.question: Will a brief internet drop get me disqualified?
faq.answer: No, temporary drops don't cause instant disqualification. The exam app caches your progress locally and syncs once you're reconnected; only a prolonged disconnection triggers a warning.

faq.question: Can I use an external monitor or run the exam app in a virtual machine?
faq.answer: No to both, a second display is automatically blocked, and the Secure Exam Application detects and blocks virtualization layers (VMware, VirtualBox, Hyper-V).

faq.question: Are headphones allowed during proctored exams?
faq.answer: No, audio must play through your system speakers with your ears visible. Bluetooth headsets and wired earphones aren't permitted.

faq.question: Do working professionals need anything extra to sit for placement drives?
faq.answer: Yes, if you're considering a job change through an LPU placement drive, you're advised to get a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your current employer before final selection.

faq.question: Which platforms are used for virtual placement drives?
faq.answer: Recruitment runs online via tools like Cocubes, Wheebox, MS Teams, and Zoom, combining digital aptitude tests, technical coding rounds, and online HR interviews.

data.question: Is counselling really free?
data.answer: Yes, always. We earn a commission from our university partners once you enrol, there's no fee to you for guidance or counselling.

data.question: How long does enrollment take?
data.answer: Most students are enrolled within 2–5 working days of submitting documents, depending on the university.

data.question: How does financing for my programme actually work?
data.answer: Financing is arranged through third-party lenders, not by Skeure, and we are still finalising which lending partners we work with. We don't publish rates, eligibility, or repayment terms here because we won't state them before they're confirmed in writing. Ask us on WhatsApp and we'll tell you exactly which options are available for your programme, including the lender's name and terms, before you commit to anything.

data.question: What's the difference between online and distance programs?
data.answer: Online programs are delivered through a dedicated learning platform with live and recorded classes. Distance programs rely more on self-study with periodic study material. We'll help you pick the right fit on WhatsApp.

data.question: Are these online degrees UGC-recognised?
data.answer: Recognition is granted per programme, per mode, and per academic session, not to a university as a whole, so we don't make a blanket claim. Each university page shows what we've confirmed and what we're still verifying against UGC-DEB records. Ask us on WhatsApp about the specific programme you're considering and we'll walk you through its current entitlement status before you apply.

data.title: How to Choose the Right Online Degree
data.description: A few questions worth asking before you commit to any online UG or PG program.

blog.body: Before comparing universities, get clear on three things: what job or next step this degree is actually for, how many hours a week you can realistically study, and whether you'd rather learn live or at your own pace.
